title: docs(sdk): use publisher/model IDs in examples
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: SDK README, option tables, authorizeUrl key examples, and JSDoc now use publisher/model IDs instead of short aliases, including in server-default notes. This makes clear that `authorizeUrl({ models: ['openai'] })` refers to one model, not every OpenAI model; the `flux` alias stores `black-forest-labs/flux.1-schnell`. The stale `seedance` video example was replaced with `bytedance/seedance-2.0`. The SDK version was bumped to `5.1.0-alpha.15`, publishing the entries previously listed as Unreleased (#17087, #17213, #17191, #17199). Runtime behavior is unchanged: aliases still work, and the `AudioModel` type is unchanged.
